name: Are We There, Yeti?
label: Quest
description: Are We There, Yeti?: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that I have what I need to cover the mechanical moving parts, I only need one other thing. Well, actually two. Two horns!

The ice thistle patriarchs and matriarchs have the largest horns, so of course, those are the ones I want. That type of yeti inhabits a cave to the southeast. There are plenty of them there; you shouldn't have any problem finding them.
Remember, I only want the best looking ones -- no beat up or broken horns, please!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I've just about finished attaching the fur, friend. Please, hurry back with those horns!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can't wait to show my friends! Now, just wait a moment while I attach these...
